## Integrity rules

- Do not include secrets, tokens, credentials, or unnecessary personal data.
- Distinguish direct observations from interpretations.
- Preserve original outputs when recording corrections.
- A sent message is not proof of a received response.
- A UI connection indicator is not proof of an operational integration.
- Human acceptance does not replace technical verification.
